subject: Trial kickoff — on-deck roster, success criteria, and SOPs
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: tim.lee@vectorx.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Trial kickoff — on-deck roster, success criteria, and SOPs

Tim — thanks for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the trial kickoff. Please skim and confirm any owner changes.

Summary of what we agreed on today:
- Trial scope: 3-week evaluation of Redwood inference for VectorX search re-ranking and chat summarization (non-PHI).
- Primary success criteria (mutually agreed):
  * Accuracy: re-rank NDCG lift >= 12% vs baseline on sample set (we’ll run A/B snapshots).
  * Latency: 95th percentile <= 220ms at 100 RPS per lane.
  * Reliability: 99.5% availability during scoped tests.
  * Integration: end-to-end inference in staging and a basic e2e smoke pass from VectorX app.
- Evaluation plan: week 0 prep + token provisioning; week 1 smoke & validation; week 2 perf & load; week 3 integration and regression checks + exec demo.

Proposed on-deck roster and RACI (first pass):
- VectorX infra owner: Tim Lee — VPC peering, test infra, and deployment window. (R)
- VectorX app owner: Maya Gupta — integration points, test cases, and acceptance (A)
- VectorX procurement: Asha Patel — contract and PO (C)
- Redwood AE (me, Karhtik) — overall trial lead, comms, and acceptance gate coordination (A)
- Redwood SE (Marissa Cole) — infra configuration, peering, load profile, perf debugging (R)
- Redwood Security (Mina Haddad) — compliance, SOC2 answers, data-retention signoff (C)
- Redwood CSM (Connor O'Brien) — onboarding checklist and post-trial rollout path (I)

Immediate asks (action items):
1) Tim/Maya: confirm procurement contact and whether VectorX needs a master services agreement or a PO-first approach.
2) Marissa: quick infra checklist below — can you confirm who owns each task by EOD?
3) Mina: I’ve attached the SOC2 summary — can you flag any missing items VectorX will ask for?
4) Team: propose 30m alignment Wed 08/11 10:00am PT (I’ll share calendar).

Attachments: redwood-trial-playbook-v1.pdf (trial runbook + test cases), SOC2-summary.pdf (summary + statement).

Thanks — I’ll convert this into a mutual action plan once we have confirmations.

—
Karhtik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karhtik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, tim.lee@vectorx.com, maya.gupta@vectorx.com
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — on-deck roster, success criteria, and SOPs

Thanks Karhtik — adding the infra-level checklist and proposed owners. I’ll own the se/tuning side and will mark tasks R/A where applicable.

Infra checklist (Marissa notes in-line):
- VPC peering & routing checks — owner: VectorX (Tim) (Need: CIDR and contact). Action: Tim to provide CIDR by 8/10.
- Firewall rules / egress for token validation — owner: VectorX (Maya) / Redwood SE will confirm required ports.
- Test token provisioning & role-based test accounts — owner: Redwood (Marissa) to create tokens; VectorX to confirm test accounts. Deliverable: test tokens by 8/11.
- Load generator profile and schedule — owner: Redwood (Marissa) with VectorX app team input. Proposed baseline 100 RPS per lane; specify peak window.
- KV cache warmup and sample corpus for NDCG — owner: VectorX (Maya) to drop sample corpus into S3 and share link.
- Monitoring & alerting hooks (trace/span tags) — owner: Redwood (Marissa) to provide tracing spec; VectorX to add the span IDs in app instrumentation.

RACI quick map (shorthand):
- Infra setup: R=VectorX (Tim), A=Marissa;
- Perf testing: R=Marissa, A=Karhtik;
- Integration smoke: R=Maya, A=Connor;
- Security signoff: R=Mina, A=Karhtik;
- Procurement: R=Asha (VectorX), A=Karhtik

I’ll create the load profiles and share a small playbook snippet for token rotation. Will aim to have infra ready for smoke by 8/12. If VectorX can confirm CIDR and S3 link by EOD Tuesday, we’ll be good.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Tim Lee <tim.lee@vectorx.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: maya.gupta@vectorx.com
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 17:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — on-deck roster, success criteria, and SOPs

Karhtik, Marissa — this looks good and aligned with what we discussed. A few quick items from the VectorX side:

- Procurement: Asha Patel (asha.patel@vectorx.com) is the formal procurement contact — she’ll own the PO/MSA flow. Asha: looping you in for visibility.
- We can provide an S3 bucket with the corpus; Maya will share the link by tomorrow 8/10.
- CIDR for peering: 10.40.0.0/16. FYI — our networking team prefers peering be done during the 8/12 maintenance window (US-PST).
- Security review: we’d like the security checklist and SOC2 evidence before week 2 perf testing. Can Redwood confirm turnaround on SOC2-derived answers?

DocuSign/contract: We prefer a short trial addendum followed by a PO. Please send DocuSign and we’ll expedite.

Confirming the 30m alignment Wed 8/11 10:00am PT — I’m in.

Thanks,
Tim
Director of Platform Engineering
VectorX
From: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
To: tim.lee@vectorx.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 17:55:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff — on-deck roster, success criteria, and SOPs

Hi Tim — thanks for the ask. Attaching the SOC2-summary.pdf with callouts below. Quick timeline and what I can provide: 

- SOC2-derived answers: I will deliver an itemized Q&A (common procurement checklist mapped to our SOC2 controls) within 48 business hours after this email (target: 8/11 morning).
- Data retention & logs: Redwood retains inference logs for 30 days by default; we can provide an export for the trial period and discuss longer retention as a commercial option.
- Access controls: we enforce RBAC for developer/ops accounts; we’ll provide the role matrix and an example audit log entry.
- Evidence requests: for anything not covered in SOC2 we’ll provide runbook screenshots or temporary access to audit extracts (timeboxed).

If VectorX has any specific fields they need for the procurement pack (e.g., encryption at rest certs, specific export formats), send them to me and I’ll prioritize.

—
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai

Perfect — appreciate the quick confirms, Tim and Asha. I’ll: 
- Send a DocuSign trial addendum + short SOW by EOD (link will come from DocuSign).
- Share the calendar invite for Wed 8/11 10:00am PT and include a short agenda (CIDR, S3 link, token provisioning, SOC2 checklist).
- Convert this thread into a mutual action plan and update owners where we get confirmations (I’ll ping Marissa for infra items and Mina for SOC2 Q&A).

Action owners (updated):
- DocuSign: Karhtik (send EOD)
- CIDR scheduling: Tim (confirm)
- S3 corpus link: Maya (deliver 8/10)
- Test tokens: Marissa (deliver 8/11)
- SOC2 Q&A: Mina (deliver 8/11 morning)

Thanks all — see you on Wed.

—
